featured_reviews.name: S S
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have been buying from Kokan Bazar for over 10 years now, and it has become a part of our everyday kitchen life. In our home, food simply doesn’t get cooked without their Malvani Masala and Fish Masala — the flavour reminds me of my Aaji’s cooking from my childhood in Konkan. The aroma, the freshness, the spice blend — nothing else comes close.

We also regularly buy their chakli and other snacks, which are always fresh and taste homemade. And our fridge is never without Kokam Crush and Raw Mango Squash — every guest who visits ends up asking where we got it from!
It has become our go-to drink to serve family and friends.

Kokan Bazar is also my favourite place for gifting traditional products — whether it’s festival hampers, housewarming gifts, or just sharing a taste of Konkan with someone special.

The staff is superb — polite, friendly, and genuinely helpful. They remember customers, offer suggestions, explain usage, and always make you feel at home.

Thank you, Kokan Bazar, for keeping the real flavours of Konkan alive. Our kitchen is incomplete without you! 🌴❤️

featured_reviews.name: rohit patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have been buying from Kokan Bazar for the past 14 years, and now we are proudly a second-generation customer. My parents introduced us to their products long ago, and since then, the taste and quality have remained consistently authentic.
Every time we open a packet of kokum, mango pulp, Diwali Faral, Malvani masala, or their homemade pickles, the aroma instantly takes us back to our Konkan roots. It’s not just about food — it’s about memories and tradition.

I have seen many brands come and go, but Kokan Bazar has always stayed true to authenticity. Their products taste just like what our grandmothers used to make.
We are absolutely hooked and can’t imagine using anything else in our kitchen.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire Kokan Bazar team for preserving the true flavours of Konkan all these years. 🙏🌴

featured_reviews.name: Dhanashrie Kanade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kokan Bazar is truly a gem for anyone who loves traditional Maharashtrian and Konkan food. Their products are not commercial or factory-made – they are handcrafted by local families and farmers from Konkan. The kokum agal, dried kokum, jackfruit chips, fresh masalas, and chutneys are absolutely amazing.
I ordered through their store and the delivery was smooth. Every item smelled fresh and tasted authentic, just like what you get in villages back home. I appreciate that they are supporting rural artisans and keeping our cultural food heritage alive. Will definitely purchase regularly!

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried Lasun Shev, Shankarpali, and Kokum syrup from KokanBazar, and the taste truly stands out. Everything feels freshly made with authentic coastal flavors. You can tell it’s traditional, homemade goodness , just like what we get back in Konkan. Highly recommend for anyone who misses that original taste!

The wooden toys from KokanBazar are absolutely delightful - beautifully handcrafted, smooth-finished, and completely safe for babies. They have that natural charm and nostalgic touch that modern plastic toys just can’t match.

featured_reviews.name: Nita Wadkar-Vaidya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visit this store whenever I am looking for something authentic, traditional and  that which reminds me of my childhood taste from Karwar. Kokanbazar is my go to place in Mumbai for  fish masala,  kokam, agal, cashews, red rice. Everything under one roof !
It genuinely feels like Kokan in Mumbai . Please do visit if you haven’t been here yet... Happy Shopping 🛒🛍️

featured_reviews.review_text:
Big Bazar is a retain chain of hypermarkets, discount department stores and grocery stores. This particular Big Bazar is really big. It has all the other sister chains like Fashion at Big Bazar (fbb), Food Bazar et cetera also here. You can find everything that you will need for your house and yourself under one roof here, from home decor, electronic appliances, furniture, toys, cosmetics, groceries to kitchen utensils. Also, everything is well managed and maintained. However, one thing that I find they can improve is to have more support staff who can guide customers. This is precisely why I have deducted one star from the rating. I would also advice them to keep chairs or sofas or make some sort of sitting arrangement in every section or department, because this store is really huge, one really gets tired if you check out every department, especially if you are with kids and elderly. Just a thought. I was also satisfied with the discounts that were on offer. At the same time, if they can up the discounts and offers in their kitchen utensils section that would be great.
Overall it really is a happening place to come shop at. If get hungry or thirsty while shopping, refreshments are also available, you will have to pay for them though..
